scope: Opt-in maintenance gate CPU boundaries and independent event/deadline replay; no model usage, token saving or live deployment

implementation.procedure: Read exact ACK, event binding, quiet bound and explicit host callable path.
implementation.acceptance: Read exact ACK, event binding, quiet bound and explicit host callable path. Confirm within CPU scope.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independently replay presentation-only repeat, due/source changes and expiry;10 bounded failure/race/config tests.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Independently replay presentation-only repeat, due/source changes and expiry;10 bounded failure/race/config tests. Confirm within CPU scope.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind current/archive sources, frozen plan and actual separate producer/reviewer logs.
data_integrity.acceptance: Bind current/archive sources, frozen plan and actual separate producer/reviewer logs. Confirm within CPU scope.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Compare exact statuses/counts and finite integer metrics; invalid clocks/JSON tested.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Compare exact statuses/counts and finite integer metrics; invalid clocks/JSON tested. Confirm within CPU scope.

measurement_validity.procedure: CPU behavioral checks only; no time/speed/model or scientific quality measurement.
measurement_validity.acceptance: CPU behavioral checks only; no time/speed/model or scientific quality measurement. Confirm within CPU scope.

reproducibility.procedure: Separate Windows producer and Linux WSL host10-test replay with distinct owner/PID.
reproducibility.acceptance: Separate Windows producer and Linux WSL host10-test replay with distinct owner/PID. Confirm within CPU scope.
